FIELD.COMMENT: Set on the ORIGINAL cert when it has been superseded by a reissue. NULL means this cert is current.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle user ID that was enrolled

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle course ID the user was enrolled into

FIELD.NAME: enrolid

TABLE.NAME: local_rtocompliance_archive_index

FIELD.COMMENT: Full ancestor path e.g. Top > Diploma of Customs Broking > Archive S1-2015

FIELD.NAME: family
FIELD.COMMENT: Qualification family (NULL = admin must assign before imports can proceed)

FIELD.NAME: is_active
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = current import target; 0 = inactive duplicate awaiting admin resolution

TABLE.NAME: local_rtocompliance_archive_active_pick
TABLE.COMMENT: Admin-chosen active archive category when a family+year+sem has duplicate candidates. Keyed on family+year+sem.

FIELD.NAME: active_categoryid
FIELD.COMMENT: Admin-selected categoryid as the import target for this family+year+sem

TABLE.NAME: local_rtocompliance_archive_meta
TABLE.COMMENT: Key-value store for archive index metadata: last rebuild hash, timestamp, row counts.

TABLE.NAME: local_rtocompliance_foe_pending

FIELD.NAME: batchid
FIELD.COMMENT: Hex token tying all rows of one apply run together

FIELD.NAME: enrolid
FIELD.COMMENT: mdl_enrol.id of the manual enrolment instance

TABLE.NAME: local_rtocompliance_qualmap
TABLE.COMMENT: Admin-defined explicit mapping from NAT qualification codes to Moodle category IDs used by the reconciler

FIELD.NAME: qualcode
FIELD.COMMENT: NAT qualification code e.g. TLI50822 — upper-cased on save

FIELD.NAME: catname
FIELD.COMMENT: Category name at time of mapping (display only — not used for lookup)

FIELD.NAME: confidence
FIELD.COMMENT: Mapping confidence 0-100; 100=certain (category_hierarchy or manual), lower values from unit_fingerprint

TABLE.NAME: local_rtocompliance_nat_classification
TABLE.COMMENT: Per-NAT-record classification output from the reconciler — MATCHED, ENROLMENT_GAP_REVIEW, UNLINKED_STUDENT_REVIEW, HISTORICAL_NO_COURSE, RECENT_NO_COURSE_REVIEW, UNCLASSIFIED

FIELD.NAME: study_year
FIELD.COMMENT: RIGHT(startdate,4) as integer — year the unit was studied

FIELD.NAME: match_path
FIELD.COMMENT: How the clientid was resolved: ID, USERNAME, EMAIL, or NONE

FIELD.NAME: course_exists
FIELD.COMMENT: 1=at least one non-CPD Moodle course teaches this unit

FIELD.NAME: enrolled_match
FIELD.COMMENT: 1=student has an enrolment in a course that covers this unit

TABLE.NAME: local_rtocompliance_qualdebug
TABLE.COMMENT: Per-unit scoring diagnostics written by the NAT reconciler Step 6 ADD engine on every run. One row per student-unit pair. Readable in Adminer without SSH.

FIELD.COMMENT: FK to local_rtocompliance_avetmiss — which import triggered this run

FIELD.NAME: sqcatid
FIELD.COMMENT: qualMap-resolved Moodle category id for the qual

FIELD.NAME: qualtype
FIELD.COMMENT: Student qual-type abbreviation e.g. INT, DCB

FIELD.NAME: dk
FIELD.COMMENT: Student NAT delivery key e.g. 2026-S1 or blank if no startdate

FIELD.NAME: poolsize
FIELD.COMMENT: Number of candidate courses in pool — 0 means no course found

FIELD.NAME: topcount
FIELD.COMMENT: How many candidates tied at the best score

FIELD.NAME: best_score
FIELD.COMMENT: Winning score; -9999 means pool was empty

FIELD.NAME: best_flags
FIELD.COMMENT: Pipe-separated scoring flags on winner e.g. sem_match|qual_branch

FIELD.NAME: course_dk
FIELD.COMMENT: Delivery key of winning course — blank means no parseable delivery key
